captions.title: Live captions
captions.mic.intro: Captions need your microphone. Your phone will ask once. Tap Allow.
captions.mic.denied: The microphone is blocked, so captions cannot start. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings, then try again.
captions.engine.label: Captions by: {engine}
captions.near_live: Captions show up a few seconds after the words are spoken. They are near-live, not word by word.
captions.log.label: Caption transcript
captions.save.failed: Could not save that note. Try again.
captions.mark.failed: Time mark {time} added, but it could not be saved as a note.
captions.unsupported: Live captions are not available in this browser. You can type captions below, or take notes with the keyboard.
captions.typed.label: Type a caption line
captions.consent.title: Download the captions model?
captions.consent.body: Better captions need a one-time download of about {size} MB. On venue Wi-Fi this can be slow. You can use browser speech instead.
captions.download.cancelled: Download cancelled. Using browser speech instead.
captions.sli.switched: Captions were falling behind, so we switched to {engine}.
captions.sli.slow_here: Captions are falling behind on this phone.
captions.sli.slow_everyone: Captions are slow for everyone right now, not your phone.
captions.gave_up: Captions stopped because no sound was heard. Check the microphone and turn captions on again.
captions.hood.title: Live captions that adapt
captions.hood.what: Captions pick the best engine for your phone, switch if they fall behind, and any line can become a note.
